name: Report Status And Reason 1
definition: Provides the related report identification and its status. If the status is rejected, a reason for this status must be given.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Provides the identification of the RegulatoryTransactionReport document that was previously sent by the reporting institution.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Indicates the status of a report message.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Indicates that the report is rejected and provides a reason why.

TypeOfStatusRule.definition: Either Status or Rejected must be present, but not both.
